concerns.location: plan.md: Summary item (3)/(5); Phase 3 & Phase 5; quickstart.md 'Current data status'
concerns.text: With TSI unavailable, training is 'skipped', yet the 'Cycle-Agnostic fallback (GSN-only RF)' still 'produces the reconstruction' (Phase 5, quickstart). A regressor needs a target; with no TSI training target the fallback model is undefined. Either it is trained on CMIP6 solar forcing — which violates FR-003 ('CMIP6 is NOT used for model training') and makes the Phase-6 CMIP6 comparison circular (validating the reconstruction against its own training target) — or it cannot exist. The plan must state explicitly what, if anything, the fallback is fit against, and if nothing, the 1610–2002 'reconstruction' is not a scientific output and Phase 5/6 as planned cannot run.

concerns.location: plan.md Phase 6 / FR-005 / SC-003; research.md §3 gap handling
concerns.text: SC-003 variance comparison across Maunder/Dalton/Modern minima is tautological under the planned gap handling: Maunder-Minimum-scale gaps (≥1 yr) are filled with a CONSTANT low-activity proxy, so the reconstructed TSI variance in the Maunder minimum is near-zero BY CONSTRUCTION, not empirically. The bootstrap test of variance differences across minima would 'confirm' a difference that is an artifact of the imputation rule. The plan needs either proxy values with realistic variability or an explicit statement that Maunder-minimum variance is not interpretable.

FR-002 defines the low-activity proxy as 'average total solar irradiance observed during the 2008–2019 minimum, expressed in W/m²', but the plan/research substitute 'mean GSN over the 2008–2019 minimum' — a sunspot number, not an irradiance. This is a unit/category error in the imputation and changes what the proxy means downstream.

The sensitivity sweep is over 'cycle-specific calibration coefficients', but no calibration coefficients exist when training is skipped (no TSI). The plan does not state what quantity the {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} threshold sweep operates on in the degraded path; as written Phase 4 has no well-defined object of analysis.
